worker_rule: Workers claim isolated shards and write only task-local result files. They never advance a shared next_batch cursor and never write localized_data directly. Normal translation follows translation_review_gate.claims_allowed; while concurrent review is enabled, WORKER_CONTINUOUS.md keeps the configured review-worker cap staffed and routes excess mass workers to translation. ChatGPT workers must apply work/worker_session_policy.json for rolling lease, checkpoints, and immediate released-claim handoff.
